paite: Josiah in vaihawm apat tung in kum giat a upa ahi; Jerusalem ah kum sawmthum-le-khat vai ahawm hi.
heading: Judah Kumpipa Josiah / (2 Kum 22.1,2)
english: Josiah was eight years old when he began to reign, and he reigned thirty-one years in Jerusalem.

paite: TOUPA mitmuh in thil hoih ahih zel a, apu David lampite azui a, taklam ah hiam, veilam ah hiam apialsan kei hi.
english: He did that which was right in Yahweh’s eyes, and walked in the ways of David his father, and didn’t turn away to the right hand or to the left.

paite: Kum giat avaihawm kum, naupangtak ahih lai a kipan him in apu David Pathian azong pan a; kum sawm-le-nih avaihawm kum in Judah gam leh Jerusalem a mun sangte, Asherte, milim bawltawmte, milim suntawmte ahihbei a.
heading: Josiah In Milim Biakna Adou
english: For in the eighth year of his reign, while he was yet young, he began to seek after the God of David his father; and in the twelfth year he began to purge Judah and Jerusalem from the high places, the Asherah poles, the engraved images, and the molten images.

paite: Baal maitamte amitmuh in achimsak ua; huaite sang a sangzaw milimte aphuk a; Asherte, milim bawltawmte, milim suntawmte ahihkham vek a, akiang ua kithoih mite han tung ah athehzak hi.
english: They broke down the altars of the Baals in his presence; and he cut down the incense altars that were on high above them. He broke the Asherah poles, the engraved images, and the molten images in pieces, made dust of them, and scattered it on the graves of those who had sacrificed to them.

paite: Siampu guhte amaitamte uah ahal a, Judah gam leh Jerusalem ahihsiang hi.
english: He burned the bones of the priests on their altars, and purged Judah and Jerusalem.

paite: Huchi mah bang in Manasseh, Ephraim, Simeon leh Naphtali khuate tan in ahih vek hi.
english: He did this in the cities of Manasseh, Ephraim, and Simeon, even to Naphtali, around in their ruins.

paite: Maitamte achimsak a, Asherte, milim bawltawmte ahihkham a, Israel gam tengteng a milimte aphuk vek a, Jerusalem ah apai nawn hi.
english: He broke down the altars, beat the Asherah poles and the engraved images into powder, and cut down all the incense altars throughout all the land of Israel, then returned to Jerusalem.

paite: Huan avaihawm kum sawm-le-giat kum, agam leh innte ahihsiang kum in Azaliah tapa Shaphan, kho ukpa Maaseiah, Joahaz tapa laigelhmi Joah TOUPA a Pathian inn bawlhoih ding in asawl hi.
heading: Dan Laibu Muhkhiakna / (2 Kum 22.3-20)
english: Now in the eighteenth year of his reign, when he had purged the land and the house, he sent Shaphan the son of Azaliah, Maaseiah the governor of the city, and Joah the son of Joahaz the recorder to repair the house of Yahweh his God.

paite: Siampu Hilkiah kiang ah ahoh ua, kongkhak ngak Levite'n Manasseh mite, Israel khosuaksunte, Judah mi leh Benjamin mite, Jerusalem a mite kiang a kipan ana lakkhawm uh, Pathian inn a hong koih uh dangka apia uhi.
english: They came to Hilkiah the high priest and delivered the money that was brought into God’s house, which the Levites, the keepers of the threshold, had gathered from the hands of Manasseh, Ephraim, of all the remnant of Israel, of all Judah and Benjamin, and of the inhabitants of Jerusalem.

paite: Huchi in TOUPA' inn lammi nasemte apia ua; TOUPA' inn nasem mite'n inn bawl mite leh zem mite apia uhi.
english: They delivered it into the hands of the workmen who had the oversight of Yahweh’s house; and the workmen who labored in Yahweh’s house gave it to mend and repair the house.

paite: Judah kumpipate'n ahihsiat uh bawlhoihna ding in suangsekte, apehnate leh a-inkamte ding sing leina ding in khutsiamte leh inn lam mite apia uhi.
english: They gave it to the carpenters and to the builders to buy cut stone and timber for couplings, and to make beams for the houses which the kings of Judah had destroyed.

paite: Huchi in mite'n muanhuaitak in nna asem ua; aheutu uh, nasep ngaihtuah mite, Merari tapate lak a Levi mi Jahath leh Obadiah, Kohath mi tapate lak a mi Zekariah leh Meshullamte ahi ua; Levi mi, midang ginglawm tumsiam tengteng toh;
english: The men did the work faithfully. Their overseers were Jahath and Obadiah the Levites, of the sons of Merari; and Zechariah and Meshullam, of the sons of the Kohathites, to give direction; and others of the Levites, who were all skillful with musical instruments.

paite: apuak a puakthoh mite heutu leh nna chiteng sem mite sep ding ngaihtuahmi ahi uhi. Laigelhmite, heutute, kongkhak ngak mite Levi mite lak a mi ahi uh.
english: Also they were over the bearers of burdens, and directed all who did the work in every kind of service. Of the Levites, there were scribes, officials, and gatekeepers.

paite: Huan TOUPA' inn a hong koih uh sumte asuah ualeh, siampu Hilkiah in Mosi zang a apiak TOUPA Dan Bu amukhia hi.
english: When they brought out the money that was brought into Yahweh’s house, Hilkiah the priest found the book of Yahweh’s law given by Moses.

paite: Huchi in Hilkiah in laigelhmi Shaphan kiang ah, "TOUPA' inn ah Dan Bu i mukheta uh," achi a. Huan Hilkiah in laibu Shaphan apia hi.
english: Hilkiah answered Shaphan the scribe, “I have found the book of the law in Yahweh’s house.” So Hilkiah delivered the book to Shaphan.

paite: Huan Shaphan in laibu kumpipa kiang ah apaipih a, "Na sikhate'n hih ding a seh a om tengteng ahih uh.
english: Shaphan carried the book to the king, and moreover brought back word to the king, saying, “All that was committed to your servants, they are doing.

paite: TOUPA' inn a dangka om abungkhia ua, heutute leh nasem mite apia uh," chi in thu atun hi.
english: They have emptied out the money that was found in Yahweh’s house, and have delivered it into the hand of the overseers and into the hand of the workmen.”

paite: Laigelhmi Shaphan in, "Siampu Hilkiah in laibu ahon pia,” chi in kumpipa ahilh a, kumpipa ma ah asim hi.
english: Shaphan the scribe told the king, saying, “Hilkiah the priest has delivered me a book.” Shaphan read from it to the king.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, kumpipa'n Dan thute azak in, apuan abotkek hi.
english: When the king had heard the words of the law, he tore his clothes.

paite: Kumpipa'n Hilkiah, Shaphan tapa Ahikam, Mikah tapa Abdon, laigelhmi Shaphan leh kumpipa sikha Asaiah thu apia hi.
english: The king commanded Hilkiah, Ahikam the son of Shaphan, Abdon the son of Micah, Shaphan the scribe, and Asaiah the king’s servant, saying,

paite: "Kuan unla, dan thu na muhkhiak tungtang thu uah kei leh Israel leh Judah gam a mite a ding in TOUPA hon dotsak dih ua; i pi-le-pute'n hiai Dan Bu a tuang bang a TOUPA thu azuih louh ziak un i tung uah TOUPA thangpaihna ahong om mahmah ngal a," chi in.
english: “Go inquire of Yahweh for me, and for those who are left in Israel and in Judah, concerning the words of the book that is found; for great is Yahweh’s wrath that is poured out on us, because our fathers have not kept Yahweh’s word, to do according to all that is written in this book.”

paite: Huchi in kumpipa'n thu apiak mite leh Hilkiah puansilh kempa Hasrah tapa Tokhat tapa Shallum zi zawlnei Huldah kiang ah ava hoh ua, huai thu ah ava houpih uhi. Amah bel Jerusalem Misneh a om ahi.
heading: Zawlnei Huldah Thudotna
english: So Hilkiah and those whom the king had commanded went to Huldah the prophetess, the wife of Shallum the son of Tokhath, the son of Hasrah, keeper of the wardrobe (now she lived in Jerusalem in the second quarter), and they spoke to her to that effect.

paite: Huan ama'n akiang uah, TOUPA, Israel' Pathian in hichi in achi, "Ka kiang a nou hon sawlpa hilh unla, TOUPA'N hichi in achi:
english: She said to them, “Yahweh, the God of Israel says: ‘Tell the man who sent you to me,

paite: 'Ngai dih ua, hiai mun leh asung a omte tung ah thil hoih lou ka tungsak ding a, Judah kumpipa ma a kisimkhia, laibu a tuang hamsia tengteng leng;
english: “Yahweh says, ‘Behold, I will bring evil on this place and on its inhabitants, even all the curses that are written in the book which they have read before the king of Judah.

paite: akhut thilhih ua hon hehsakna ding ua hon lehngatsan a, milim dangte ding a gimlim ahal ziak un hiai mun tung ah ka hehna sun ahi a, daihsak ahi kei ding,' chi in.
english: Because they have forsaken me, and have burned incense to other gods, that they might provoke me to anger with all the works of their hands, therefore my wrath is poured out on this place, and it will not be quenched.’”’

paite: Himahleh TOUPA thu dong ding a nou hon sawlpa Judah kumpipa kiang ah, hichibang in chi un, TOUPA, Israel' Pathian in hichi in achi, 'Na thuzakte tungtang thu ah,
english: But to the king of Judah, who sent you to inquire of Yahweh, you shall tell him this, ‘Yahweh, the God of Israel says: “About the words which you have heard,

paite: na lungtang hihnem a a-om ziak a Pathian ma a na kiniamkhiak a, hiai mun tungtang thu leh asung a omte tungtang thu na zak a, ka ma a na kiniamkhiak a, na puan na bohkek a, ka ma a na kah ziak in ke'n leng na thu ka na ngaikhia hi.
english: because your heart was tender, and you humbled yourself before God when you heard his words against this place and against its inhabitants, and have humbled yourself before me, and have torn your clothes and wept before me, I also have heard you,” says Yahweh.

paite: Ngai dih, na pi leh na pute kiang ah ka hon hohsak ding a, na han ah lungmuangtak in na pai ding a, hiai mun leh asung a omte tung a ka hon tunsak ding thil hoih lou tengteng na mit in amu kei ding, chi in gen in,' achi hi. Huchi in kumpipa kiang ah thu atunta uhi.
english: “Behold, I will gather you to your fathers, and you will be gathered to your grave in peace. Your eyes won’t see all the evil that I will bring on this place and on its inhabitants.”’” They brought back this message to the king.

paite: Huchi in kumpipa'n mi asawl a, Judah gam leh Jerusalem a upa tengteng asamkhawm hi.
heading: Josiah In TOUPA Thu Mang Ding In Thukhun Abawl / (2 Kum 23.1-20)
english: Then the king sent and gathered together all the elders of Judah and Jerusalem.

paite: Huchi in kumpipa leh Judah mi tengteng leh Jerusalem a mi tengteng, siampu leh Levite, mipi tengteng aneu leh alian in TOUPA' inn ah ahohtou ua; TOUPA' inn a muhkhiak thukhun bu a thu tengteng abil ua zak in asim hi.
english: The king went up to Yahweh’s house with all the men of Judah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem—the priests, the Levites, and all the people, both great and small—and he read in their hearing all the words of the book of the covenant that was found in Yahweh’s house.

paite: Kumpipa bel amun ah adingh a, huai laibu a tuang thukunte hihkip ding in alungtang tengteng, akha tengteng a ToUPA zui ding leh athupiakte, athu theihsakte, adan thusehte pom ding in TOUPA ma ah thu akhung uhi.
english: The king stood in his place and made a covenant before Yahweh, to walk after Yahweh, and to keep his commandments, his testimonies, and his statutes with all his heart and with all his soul, to perform the words of the covenant that were written in this book.

paite: Jerusalem leh Benjamin mi tengteng huchibang a om ding in achi ua. Huan Jerusalem a mite'n Pathian, apipute uh Pathian thukhun bang in ahihta uhi.
english: He caused all who were found in Jerusalem and Benjamin to stand. The inhabitants of Jerusalem did according to the covenant of God, the God of their fathers.

paite: Huchi in Josiah hi in Israel gam in ahuap tengteng a kipan thilkihhuai tengteng apaimang a, Israel gam a om tengteng TOUPA a Pathian uh nna asemsak hi. Adamsung in TOUPA apipute uh Pathian azuih uh apialsan kei uhi.
english: Josiah took away all the abominations out of all the countries that belonged to the children of Israel, and made all who were found in Israel to serve, even to serve Yahweh their God. All his days they didn’t depart from following Yahweh, the God of their fathers.
